package usecase

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func (runtime *Runtime) ListSubmissions(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID, cursor string, limit int) ([]domain.Submission, string, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) || limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return nil, "", domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	if _, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	items, next, err := runtime.Repository.ListSubmissions(ctx, instanceID, cursor, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	for index := range items {
		items[index] = items[index].PublicProjection()
	}
	return items, next, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) GetSubmission(ctx context.Context, studentID, instanceID, submissionID string) (domain.Submission, error) {
	if _, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstance(ctx, studentID, instanceID); err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, err
	}
	submission, err := runtime.Repository.GetSubmission(ctx, instanceID, submissionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, err
	}
	return submission.PublicProjection(), nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) RetryProvisioning(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) (domain.StartResult, int, error) {
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(instanceID) {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 0, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	instance, err := runtime.Repository.GetInstanceByID(ctx, instanceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StartResult{}, statusFor(err), err
	}
	if instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceStarting {
		return domain.StartResult{}, 409, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	instance, err = runtime.provision(ctx, instance)
	if err != nil {
		return runtime.started(instance), 202, nil
	}
	return runtime.started(instance), 200, nil
}

func (runtime *Runtime) ProcessPendingValidations(ctx context.Context, limit int) (int, error) {
	if limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return 0, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	pending, err := runtime.Repository.PendingValidationRuns(ctx, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	processed := 0
	for _, item := range pending {
		if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(ctx, item); err != nil {
			return processed, err
		}
		processed++
	}
	return processed, nil
}
